name: executor
title: Executor
description: Run connected tools, automate with Raycast AI, and manage your Executor workspaces
author: jerichosequitin

commands.name: search-tools
commands.title: Search Tools
commands.subtitle: Executor
commands.description: Find connected tools, fill in native input forms, review calls, and inspect results

commands.name: integrations
commands.title: Browse Integrations
commands.subtitle: Executor
commands.description: Browse your integrations and jump into their tools or open their settings in Executor

commands.name: connections
commands.title: Manage Connections
commands.subtitle: Executor
commands.description: Inspect recorded health, reconnect accounts, edit labels, and resync connection tools

commands.name: artifacts
commands.title: Browse Artifacts
commands.subtitle: Executor
commands.description: Browse, edit, and delete saved Executor artifacts

commands.name: saved-tools
commands.title: Saved Tools
commands.subtitle: Executor
commands.description: Run favorite tools and reuse saved input presets

commands.name: add-connection
commands.title: Add Connection
commands.subtitle: Executor
commands.description: Add an Executor connection with native credential entry or provider authorization.

commands.name: add-integration
commands.title: Add Integration
commands.subtitle: Executor
commands.description: Search the integration catalog or add a custom MCP, OpenAPI, or GraphQL endpoint

commands.name: policies
commands.title: Manage Policies
commands.subtitle: Executor
commands.description: Search, create, edit, and remove tool policies with explicit scope and action review

commands.name: approvals
commands.title: Review Approvals
commands.subtitle: Executor
commands.description: Review current server terms for pauses started through this extension

commands.name: status
commands.title: Executor Status
commands.subtitle: Executor
commands.description: View recorded connection health and extension approvals from the menu bar

commands.name: workspaces
commands.title: Manage Workspaces
commands.subtitle: Executor
commands.description: Add, edit, verify, or switch Executor workspaces

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Default Workspace API Key
preferences.description: Optional existing workspace key. Use Manage Workspaces to add more organizations with separate keys.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Server URL
preferences.description: Origin of the Executor server. Use http://127.0.0.1:4788 for the local daemon or your own host when self-hosting. Defaults to https://executor.sh.

preferences.name: defaultOwner
preferences.title: Default Connection Visibility
preferences.description: Show personal connections, workspace connections, or both within the default workspace.

tools.name: update-integration
tools.title: Update Integration Details
tools.description: Update an integration's display name or description with explicit workspace and change confirmation; use this management tool instead of execute-code

tools.name: discover-tools
tools.title: Discover Tools
tools.description: Find tools for a standalone catalog lookup; for multi-step tasks prefer discovery inside execute-code

tools.name: describe-tool
tools.title: Describe Tool
tools.description: Inspect one tool schema; for multiple schemas prefer batching tools.describe.tool inside execute-code

tools.name: call-tool
tools.title: Call Tool
tools.description: Run one already-described tool with reviewed JSON arguments; prefer execute-code for multi-call workflows

tools.name: execute-code
tools.title: Execute Code
tools.description: Preferred for multi-step connected-service work: batch discovery, inspect schemas, compose calls, paginate, and summarize results in Executor's TypeScript code mode

tools.name: resume-execution
tools.title: Resume Execution
tools.description: Continue, decline, or cancel an exact paused execution after reviewing fresh server terms

tools.name: list-integrations
tools.title: List Integrations
tools.description: List configured Executor integrations

tools.name: list-connections
tools.title: List Connections
tools.description: Inspect connected accounts and reported health for an integration

tools.name: list-artifacts
tools.title: List Artifacts
tools.description: Find reusable saved Executor artifacts

tools.name: get-artifact
tools.title: Get Artifact
tools.description: Retrieve a saved artifact, its source, and connection bindings

tools.name: list-workspaces
tools.title: List Workspaces
tools.description: List configured Executor workspace identities before selecting a target for AI tools

tools.name: list-policies
tools.title: List Policies
tools.description: Read current tool policies with exact IDs, scopes, and review fingerprints

tools.name: manage-policy
tools.title: Manage Policy
tools.description: Create, update, or delete an explicitly requested tool policy with current rule review

tools.name: manage-workspace
tools.title: Manage Workspace
tools.description: Rename or update a local workspace name and connection filter, switch, verify, or remove a profile.

tools.name: open-executor-view
tools.title: Open Executor View
tools.description: Open native commands, preferences, or private workspace credential setup

tools.name: open-executor-page
tools.title: Open Executor Page
tools.description: Open an exact workspace console page or artifact in the browser

tools.name: list-approvals
tools.title: List Approvals
tools.description: List local references to paused executions started through this extension

tools.name: get-approval
tools.title: Get Approval
tools.description: Read fresh server terms and the fingerprint for one exact paused execution

tools.name: get-status
tools.title: Get Status
tools.description: Read recorded connection health and local approval counts without probing providers

tools.name: rename-artifact
tools.title: Update Artifact Details
tools.description: Update an artifact title or description. Omitted fields stay unchanged; an empty description clears it.

tools.name: delete-artifact
tools.title: Delete Artifact
tools.description: Permanently delete one exact saved Executor artifact with explicit workspace and target confirmation

tools.name: list-saved-tools
tools.title: List Saved Tools
tools.description: List workspace-scoped local Executor favorites and saved input presets

tools.name: get-saved-tool
tools.title: Get Saved Tool
tools.description: Read one exact local Executor favorite or saved input preset

tools.name: save-favorite
tools.title: Save Favorite
tools.description: Save one exact Executor tool as a workspace-scoped local favorite

tools.name: save-tool-preset
tools.title: Save Tool Preset
tools.description: Save reviewed inputs for one exact Executor tool as a workspace-scoped local preset

tools.name: update-saved-tool
tools.title: Update Saved Tool
tools.description: Update the title or inputs of one exact local favorite or preset

tools.name: remove-saved-tool
tools.title: Remove Saved Tool
tools.description: Remove one exact local Executor favorite or preset

tools.name: execute-saved-preset
tools.title: Execute Saved Preset
tools.description: Run an unchanged reviewed preset with Executor policy and pause handling

tools.name: update-connection
tools.title: Update Connection Details
tools.description: Update one exact connection label or description with change confirmation

tools.name: check-connection-health
tools.title: Check Connection Health
tools.description: Run and persist a fresh health check for one exact connection

tools.name: resync-connection
tools.title: Resync Connection Tools
tools.description: Resync tools for one exact connection with explicit confirmation

tools.name: reconnect-connection
tools.title: Reconnect Connection
tools.description: Reconnect one exact connection through guarded OAuth or secure browser handoff

tools.name: add-connection
tools.title: Add Connection
tools.description: Open native connection setup for an exact workspace and integration. Credentials are entered privately in Raycast; provider authorization may open in a browser.

tools.name: search-integration-catalog
tools.title: Search Integration Catalog
tools.description: Search the public integration catalog with bounded pagination and type filters

tools.name: prepare-integration-setup
tools.title: Prepare Integration Setup
tools.description: Open native Raycast integration setup for a catalog item or custom endpoint in the exact workspace

tools.name: create-integration
tools.title: Add Integration
tools.description: Create and verify a remote MCP, OpenAPI, or GraphQL integration directly. Declare authentication without credentials; connect an account separately.

tools.name: output-action
tools.title: Copy or Export Output
tools.description: Copy requested text or formatted JSON, or export JSON to the private exports directory

tools.name: delete-integration
tools.title: Delete Integration
tools.description: Permanently delete a removable integration and its connections/tools with explicit workspace confirmation

tools.name: delete-connection
tools.title: Delete Connection
tools.description: Permanently delete one exact connection with confirmation; keep its integration and other connections
